included in the solicitation.

Our inspection and cleaning
methodology includes tank draining coordination with Facility Services,

The mention of SDS management is relevant but not sufficient to confirm compliance with the specific requirement. There is no direct mention of a defined methodology, nor is there a clear contradiction. Therefore, the information provided is insufficient to determine compliance.
